findings: DownloadSPOFiles lists direct file children into a shared temp directory by filename, then moves every temp child. It has no invocation-specific isolation, digest verification, recursive traversal or explicit content-identity test; preexisting temp files are also eligible for the move.
AssignO365Admin assigns a selected role to every input UPN; no file deduplication.

getfailedscheduledtasks filters by status codes and TaskPath after stripping every backslash. Distinct hierarchical paths can normalize to the same string; it sends one notification per returned failed task. No notifications sent during review.
ExportAdattributes writes twelve user attributes to Excel. The explicit unlimited sizelimit option is commented; completeness depends on external Quest defaults. No file comparisons.

automationmetricsspo retrieves paged list items, filters Created strictly between dates, and appends one summary row; exact endpoints are excluded and repeated runs append repeated rows. Page size is not treated here as an overall result limit.
executed_controls: Verified all five original Git blob IDs against pinned tree.
limits: Static source review only; no downloaded scripts executed, no remote services or credentials used.
41/248 tracked blobs reviewed; repository remains partial.
These findings are not measured library optimizations or runtime regressions.
